inputs.question: Are there any overhead distribution lines shown on the electrical plan or utility plan near the transformer pads? If yes, what is the minimum horizontal distance from the transformer pads to any overhead line?
inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer locations lack minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead distribution line conductors (primary, neutral, and secondary), extending from ground to sky
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent question includes a presence check ("Are there any overhead distribution lines...") but the primary and substantive part asks for the minimum horizontal distance measurement between transformer pads and overhead lines, which directly addresses the 7.5-foot clearance requirement. The measurement component takes precedence.
